text.tspan: Governance Pillars: The Common Layer Under Every Standard
Every control from every standard is tagged to one of 5 pillars, built on the 7 trustworthy-AI characteristics (NIST AI RMF)

g.text: BUILT ON 7 TRUSTWORTHY-AI CHARACTERISTICS (NIST AI RMF) — the measurable primitives behind every pillar

text.tspan: Pillar tags let the aggregation step spot when fixing ONE gap (e.g. encryption) simultaneously satisfies controls in TWO different standards.
